lines.zh: 我从那边的门里走出来。
lines.en: I come out of that door.
I stop at each step, as if learning the way.
The patterns on the wall move.

lines.zh: 我脚下踩着的东西很软。

lines.en: I shift slowly into the light.

lines.zh: 我的影子拖在后面，慢一步。
lines.en: My shadow trails a step behind me.
It takes a step before I do.
I've walked this dimension a long while.
I go around the holes in the ground.
I stop and look down that corridor.

lines.zh: 我站着，脸上的噪点不停。
lines.en: I stand still while static crawls across my face.

lines.zh: 这里的声音像从很远来。
lines.en: The sounds here come from far off.
I glance up at the lamp.
The ceiling above has no edge.

lines.zh: 我的头歪向一边，停住了。
lines.en: My head tilts to one side and stays there.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，铁锈味就散不开。
lines.en: Where I stand, the smell of rust lingers.
I turn my body away a little.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋召来的我，独自站着。
lines.en: Called by a spawn egg, I stand alone.
Nothing else to do here but wait.
The tube light hums above me.

lines.zh: 你不用回头，我在你正前方。
lines.en: No need to look back; I am right in front of you.
Which way did you come from?
That little light does not reach me.
That will let them see you.

lines.zh: 把光源收好，我不喜欢亮。
lines.en: Put the light away; I dislike brightness.

lines.zh: 在这条走廊，你走得太响。
lines.en: You walk too loudly in this corridor.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯，让我眯起眼。
lines.en: The lamp in your hand makes me squint.
Don't look at me. Look behind you.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我记在名单上了。
lines.en: Your name is on my list now.
The blade passed through; my shadow closed again.
I lean back into the wall.
My outline scatters, then slowly gathers.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我的影像闪了闪。
lines.en: That blow makes my image flicker.
I'm Mazin. That's all you get.
The wall is counting for you.
What are you holding that up for?

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，我要别的。
lines.en: Food does nothing for me; I want something else.
Put that thing in your pocket.
I hear a sound far off.

lines.zh: 你撞到了我，刷怪蛋的壳还没冷。
lines.en: You bumped into me; my spawn egg shell is still warm.

lines.zh: 我们两个人影叠在一起。

lines.en: This corridor is narrow; do not walk so close.
After you stepped away, a shadow remained.

lines.zh: 我连自己是什么都不记得。
lines.en: I can't recall what I am.
This isn't the place for that.

lines.zh: 别问我的名字，念出来会出事。
lines.en: Do not ask my name; speaking it causes trouble.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，影像晃了一下。
lines.en: I pick it up and my image wavers.

lines.zh: 指节太僵，我拿不了太久。
lines.en: My knuckles are too stiff to hold it long.
It grew heavier in my hand.
This doesn't belong to this dimension.
It will find its own way back.
Don't pick it up a second time.
A mark remains on my hand.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，在这层楼回响。
lines.en: Your heartbeat echoes through this floor.
This body is bolted iron plate.
You heard it too, didn't you?
We have to choose a side.
Don't walk off. Don't look back.

lines.zh: 我从那边的门里出来，路我不熟。
lines.en: I come out of that door; I do not know this path.

lines.zh: 你身后的门，自己合上了。
lines.en: The door behind you closes by itself.
I say nothing, just walk beside you.
Last time it was the other side.
The cracks in the wall follow us.
If you look back, the shadow stops.
The lamps pass overhead one by one.
Ahead, the lights go out one by one.
I try to walk behind your steps.

lines.zh: 我把你往门里拽，别出声。
lines.en: I pull you through the door. Stay quiet.

lines.zh: 手按在你肩上，别转过来。
lines.en: My hand is on your shoulder, do not turn.
I let go and stepped back.
The wall will remember your scent.
I come out of that wall.
The shadow came first, then the body.
This dimension is meant to be like this.
You stand at the edge of the light.

lines.zh: 从墙角站起来，我比你高。
lines.en: Rising from the corner, I stand taller than you.

lines.zh: 这里数过的人里，没有你。
lines.en: You are not among those I have counted here.
So we're alike, in a way.
I know a few of the doors.
The stairs are at the corridor's end.

lines.zh: 火在这里烧得没有温度。

lines.en: Water spilled from the wall, fast.
After the blast, the corridor was wider.
The arrow went through and stuck in the wall.

lines.zh: 一道光扫进来，影子缩了。
lines.en: Light swept in, and the shadow shrank.
I don't eat, so I don't starve.

lines.zh: 雷声让墙上的缝全张开了。
lines.en: The thunder opened every crack in the wall.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的噪点都停了。
lines.en: In the void even my static stops.
